valve_span_text: Within the second chamber 26 is a valve seat 28 and a resilient diaphragm valve 30 seated in the valve seat. The valve seat is supported by the interior structure of the body of the shunt. The diaphragm valve can be selected so as to maintain a predetermined shunt pressure within the shunt. That is, the diaphragm valve 30 can be selected so that it opens to permit fluid flow only when a preselected fluid pressure is achieved in the second chamber 26. Preferably, the diaphragm valve is a one-way valve. Also within the body of the shunt is a third chamber 32.
